integrity: The unrestricted symbolic proof appears in RESULT.md; exact finite verification is separately reproducible and is not a substitute for the proof. Classical discriminant-square characterization and dyadic support results are prior work. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The classification concerns exact full-period residue fibers and their moments, not partial windows or higher-degree figurate polynomials. Its proof uses classical prime-power square-root counting and CRT. Possible unindexed equivalent statements, and incomplete direct access to the relevant primary full-text, remain originality risks.
title: Exact fibers and all moments of triangular residues modulo arbitrary integers
